minecraft:behavior.swell.description: Allows the mob to swell and trigger an explosion. MUST be paired with minecraft:explode.

minecraft:explode.description: Defines the actual explosion properties. Required for mobs that swell.

minecraft:target_nearby_sensor.description: Triggers events based on player proximity. Useful for starting the swell behavior.

minecraft:behavior.leap_at_target.description: Allows the mob to leap at its target.

properties.must_be_on_ground: Whether it must be on ground to leap

properties.track_target: Whether to track the target's position

minecraft:behavior.avoid_mob_type.description: Allows the mob to run away from specific mob types (e.g., cats, ocelots).

properties.max_dist: Distance to keep from the avoided mob

minecraft:behavior.panic.description: Allows the mob to run away when hurt.

minecraft:behavior.mount_pathing.description: Allows the mob to path towards a mount (like a spider jockey).

minecraft:behavior.defend_village_target.description: Iron Golem style village defense behavior.

minecraft:is_charged.description: Marks the entity as charged (like a charged creeper).

minecraft:knockback_resistance.description: Reduces knockback taken by the mob.

minecraft:teleport.description: Allows the mob to teleport (Enderman style).

notes: Reference from Mojang/bedrock-samples. Use these components to customize AI behavior. TIP: To make a mob only explode and NOT melee attack, add 'minecraft:behavior.melee_attack': null to the components.
